tools.name: list_matches
tools.description: Matches currently in the feed (teams, kickoff, lock deadline, status, result) without the consensus fields. Use get_consensus for the crowd’s picks.

tools.name: get_consensus
tools.description: The crowd’s prediction per match: 1X2 shares of the sample, top-3 exact scorelines (Daily modes), and an expert cohort weighted by Weltrang ranking. Pass an id (e.g. "classic:btm:7:14") for one match, or mode/status filters for a list. outcome is null while fewer than minCohort tippers have picked.

tools.name: get_crowd_record
tools.description: How often the crowd’s majority pick was right, per competition and season. Not published yet; the tool answers with available:false until the historical archive is wired in.
